words: Up to 2350 US cents is all I can lay out - not a penny over, I'm pruning tight this month. Only things that can be ordered today - that's the rule I'm going by. Hi there - I'd love to buy something from home soundbars, speakers & subwoofers - and the sensitivity should be at least 93 db. The one you pick - its plug type should come out as a good fit for the value listed for the power supply units that the seller Belnosalen has - with wattage 300 w - and chase up any listing its page points to. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. What would suit our sitting room best – cartoons all afternoon with the kids – then my old vinyl at night once they're asleep? We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not.
